converter.description: 16-bit, 4-channel delta-sigma ADC with I2C interface, PGA and on-board reference
converter.note: 22226a.pdf (Microchip DS22226A, MCP3426/7/8): p.6 electrical characteristics (VDD 2.7-5.5 V), p.11 Table 3-1 pins (MCP3428 TSSOP: 1 CH1+, 2 CH1-, 3 CH2+, 4 CH2-, 5 VSS, 6 VDD, 7 SDA, 8 SCL, 9 Adr0, 10 Adr1, 11 CH3+, 12 CH3-, 13 CH4+, 14 CH4-), p.18 Register 5-1 configuration register (power-on 90h: RDY 1, channel 1, continuous, 240 SPS, gain 1), p.20-21 device code 1101 and Table 5-3 address bits (Adr0, Adr1: low/low 000, high/low 100, low/high 010, high/high 110; the floating states give 001, 101, 011, 111 and cannot be told from a tie, so they have no table entry), p.21-22 write (one configuration byte) and read (data bytes, then the configuration byte), p.22 general call reset, p.53 product identification (MCP3428-E/ST). Left out: the 12- and 14-bit output widths of the 240 and 60 SPS rates (the result is always 16 bits), the PGA, general call latch and conversion; S1-S0 = 11 converts at 15 SPS.

registers.name: CONFIG
registers.note: reset 90h; bit 7 reads the ready status (0 = the output register holds a new result)

commands.name: Write Configuration
commands.note: one configuration byte after the address byte (Figure 5-3)

converter.description: Dual 7-bit sink/source current DAC with I2C interface
converter.note: DS4432.pdf (Maxim 19-4744): p.1 ordering information (DS4432U+, 8 uSOP) and pin configuration, p.2 recommended operating conditions (VCC 2.7-5.5 V), p.4 pin description (1 SDA, 2 SCL, 3 FS1, 4 GND, 5 FS0, 6 OUT0, 7 OUT1, 8 VCC), p.6 memory organization (F8h OUT0, F9h OUT1; each register: bit 7 sign, 1 = source, bits 6-0 the current setting; zero current at power-up), I2C slave address 90h (7-bit 48h), p.8 write (memory address, data) and read (set the address, then read). The sign bit is stored; an output's code is the 7-bit magnitude.

commands.name: Memory address
commands.note: the first write byte is the memory address (F8h or F9h); the next byte writes that register, a read returns it

converter.description: 12-bit nanoDAC with SPI interface, rail-to-rail voltage output
converter.note: AD5601_5611_5621.pdf (Analog Devices, rev. I): p.4 specifications (VDD 2.7-5.5 V), p.6 pin function descriptions (SC70: 1 SYNC, 2 SCLK, 3 SDIN, 4 VDD, 5 GND, 6 VOUT), p.14 serial interface (16-bit shift register, data clocked in on the falling edge of SCLK, register updated on the 16th falling edge; SYNC high earlier aborts the write) and Figure 41 input register (DB15-DB14 PD1-PD0, DB13-DB2 the 12 data bits, DB1-DB0 ignored), p.16 Table 6 power-down modes (stored, not acted on), power-on reset to zero scale, p.21 ordering guide (AD5621AKSZ-REEL7, KS-6).

registers.name: DAC
registers.note: DAC register; power-on reset fills it with zeros

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: PD1/PD0 mode bits of the last valid frame (Table 6; 00 normal operation at power on)

commands.name: WRITE
commands.note: DB15-DB14 PD1/PD0, then the data MSB first, then two ignored bits; executed on the 16th SCLK falling edge; SYNC high earlier aborts the frame
